episodes.synopsis: Before the events of Bakemonogatari, Koyomi and Tsubasa delve into the  mystery surrounding a stone that was enshrined into one of the school's  gardens.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Stone

episodes.synopsis: After Hitagi's condition is treated, she and Koyomi investigate the true  reason why some flowers were left behind on a street and the school's  rooftop.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Flower

episodes.synopsis: After Oshino leaves the city, Mayoi informs Koyomi about a sand box  whose shape resembles a devil and he decides to find out why.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Sand

episodes.synopsis: After Koyomi helps Kanbaru tidying her room, he has a bath in her house,  and finds out a curious story about the water of the tub.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Water

episodes.synopsis: Nadeko comes over to Koyomi's house, and is pleasantly surprised that  Koyomi's parents and siblings are all absent. The two then engage in a  discussion about Kaiki's curse and his means of spreading the rumor  amongst the middle schoolers in town.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Wind

episodes.synopsis: Karen asked Koyomi for advice regarding a mysterious grown tree that suddenly appeared on her dojo's backyard.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Tree

episodes.synopsis: Tsukihi consults Koyomi regarding her Tea Club members on why her fellow  members still believe in the ghostly "eight member" despite Tsukihi  proving the rumor was fake.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Tea

episodes.synopsis: As Ougi and Koyomi climb the mountain where the North White Snake Shrine is located, she tells him that the shrine was moved there from another mountain.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Mountain

episodes.synopsis: When Koyomi gets donuts from Hitagi, Shinobu tries to eat all of the donuts.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Torus

episodes.synopsis: On his way home, Araragi sees Yotsugi, who asks him for help finding something.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Seed

episodes.synopsis: When Koyomi asks Yozuru Kagenui about the extent of her relationship with Yotsugi, she challenges him to a fight. But then Yozuru disappears...
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Nothing

episodes.synopsis: On Exam day, Koyomi visits the North White Snake shrine to look for Kozuru. Instead he sees Izuko Gaen there.
episodes.title: Koyomimonogatari: Koyomi Dead
